deposit(uint256,address).details: See {IERC4626-deposit}.This function will call DEPOSIT hook if enabled.

returns._2: Amount of interest left to distribute.

harvest().details: When harvesting a net negative yield amount, the loss amount will be instantly deducted,         and this will drop the vault's share price. Therefore, Euler Earn shares should never be used as collateral in any other protocol.This function does not check for the cooldown period.

returns._0: True if harvest checks for cooldown period, else false.

maxDeposit(address).details: Not protected with `nonReentrantView()` because it does call `previewMint()` which has the `nonReentrantView()` modifier.This function does not simulate the hook behavior called in the actual `deposit()` function.

maxRedeem(address).details: See {IERC4626-maxRedeem}.      This function does not simulate the hook behavior called in the actual `redeem()` function.      This function return an underestimated amount when `_owner` is the current fee recipient address and performance fee > 0.

maxWithdraw(address).details: See {IERC4626-maxWithdraw}.      This function does not simulate the hook behavior called in the actual `withdraw()` function.      This function return an underestimated amount when `_owner` is the current fee recipient address and performance fee > 0.

EVC().notice: Returns the address of the Ethereum Vault Connector (EVC) used by this contract.

convertToAssets(uint256).notice: Convert to an apprximation of the amount of assets that the Vault would exchange for the amount of shares provided.

convertToShares(uint256).notice: Convert to an approximation of the amount of shares that the Vault would exchange for the amount of assets provided.

decimals().notice: Return the euler earn token decimals.

deposit(uint256,address).notice: Deposit `_assets` amount into the euler earn.

isCheckingHarvestCoolDown().notice: Return if harvest cooldown check is on.

maxDeposit(address).notice: Returns the maximum amount of the underlying asset that can be deposited into the euler earn.

maxMint(address).notice: Returns the maximum amount of the Vault shares that can be minted for the receiver.

maxRedeem(address).notice: Returns the maximum amount of Vault shares that can be redeemed from the owner balance in the Vault.

maxWithdraw(address).notice: Returns the maximum amount of the underlying asset that can be withdrawn from the owner balance.

name().notice: Returns the name of the euler earn.

permit2Address().notice: Return the address of Permit2 contract.

previewDeposit(uint256).notice: Preview a deposit call and return the amount of shares to be minted.

previewMint(uint256).notice: Preview a mint call and return the amount of assets to be deposited.

previewRedeem(uint256).notice: Preview a redeem call and return the amount of assets to be withdrawn.

previewWithdraw(uint256).notice: Preview a withdraw call and return the amount of shares to be burned.

redeem(uint256,address,address).notice: Redeem `_shares` amount from euler earn. This function will try to withdraw from cash reserve,         if not enough, will loop through the strategies following the withdrawal queue order till the withdraw amount is filled.

totalAssets().notice: Return the total amount of assets deposited, plus the accrued interest.

totalAssetsDeposited().notice: Get the total assets deposited into the euler earn.

totalSupply().notice: Return the euler earn total balance.

updateInterestAccrued().notice: Update accrued interest and count it in the total assets deposited.

withdraw(uint256,address,address).notice: Withdraw `_assets` amount from euler earn. This function will try to withdraw from cash reserve,         if not enough, will loop through the strategies following the withdrawal queue order till the withdraw amount is filled.
